nonblocking_findings.locator: Candidate Document Header; 文件身分與用途
nonblocking_findings.description: Visual layout and multi-column pagination across pages within the native Word environment remain to be confirmed via native Word visual inspection, though all required sections, tables, and extracted textual contents are complete.

Composite customer value relative change is calculated and reported as 23.08% in Table 3A (0.75 / 3.25 = 23.0769%), whereas the Blueprint overview text cites 23.1%; both representations are mathematically accurate at 2 vs 1 decimal places.
Action roles and completion deadlines are maintained as unassigned placeholders ('待指派', '核定後'), which appropriately preserves organizational governance boundaries prior to official authorization.
